<h2>Make sjSDM Tuning Branch Work Items</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Converts public tuning work items into a branchable table. Empty inputs
produce one explicit non-fitting sentinel so 'targets' does not branch
over an empty target.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_sjsdm_tuning_branch_work_items(data_work_items = NULL)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_work_items">data_work_items</code></td>
<td>
<p>Work-item table returned by [build_sjsdm_tuning_work_items()]. It may be
empty when cross-validation is scientifically inapplicable.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Work-item tibble with additive 'tuning_applicable'. Non-empty inputs retain
every row and set the flag to 'TRUE'; empty inputs return one typed sentinel
row with the flag set to 'FALSE'.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
build_sjsdm_tuning_branch_work_items(
  data_work_items = data_sjsdm_tuning_work_items
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>

</main>
